description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch Tasklet responsible for processing and sending SMS messages through an external gateway. It fetches pending SMS messages, updates their status, and sends them asynchronously. The class also manages threading and handles application context shutdown events.

classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that processes pending SMS messages, updates their status, and sends them via an external gateway, utilizing asynchronous execution and handling application shutdown events.
